description: Conversion of single family dwelling house into 2x maisonettes, involving rear outrigger dormer, front rooflight, alterations to external fenestrations and provision for refuse and cycle storage.
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
The external finishing materials shall match those used in the construction of the existing building and/or areas of hard surfacing. Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:2025/1730/1 rev 2, 2025/1730/ 2 rev 1, 2025/1730/3, Energy statement, Planning statement    Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until details of the 4 long-stay cycle parking spaces have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. These details should demonstrate: Location: Near entrances or main access Design: Stands or wall bars Security: Secure, overlooked, well-lit Coverage: Covered Accessibility: Step-free, no obstructions The cycle parking spaces shall be fully constructed in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation and shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development. Reason: To ensure that adequate cycle parking facilities are provided to promote sustainable modes of transport

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until waste storage and recycling facilities to satisfy the future number of occupiers on site have been provided within the development, in accordance with the Enfield's Household Recycling and Waste Planning Guidance for New Developments (February 2024). Such facilities to be retained for the lifetime of the development. Reason: To ensure that adequate waste and recycling storage facilities are provided to meet the needs of future occupiers, promote sustainable waste management practices, and support borough-wide recycling targets.

Prior to occupation of the development hereby approved, the rear gardens shall be enclosed in accordance with details to be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The means of enclosure shall be erected in accordance with the approved detail before the development is occupied.Reason: To ensure satisfactory appearance and safeguard the privacy, amenity and safety of adjoining occupiers.

The development shall be completed with a system of sustainable drainage with source control SuDS measures such as green roofs, rain gardens and permeable paving, unless otherwise agreed by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure the sustainable management of water, minimise flood risk, minimise discharge of surface water outside of the curtilage of the property and ensure that the drainage system will remain functional throughout the lifetime of the development in accordance with Policy CP28 of the Core Strategy, DMD Policy 61, and Policies SI12 & SI13 of the London Plan 2021 and the NPPF 2026

The development shall not be occupied until an Energy Statement has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall thereafter be carried out in full accordance with the approved Energy Statement unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To ensure that the development contributes to sustainable design and construction, and that CO"² emissions reduction targets are met in accordance with Policy CP20 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), and Policies DMD49, DMD50, and DMD51 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

Following practical completion of works a final Energy Performance Certificate with accompanying Building Regulations compliance report shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Where applicable, a Display Energy Certificate shall be submitted within 18 months following first occupation.Reason: In the interest of sustainable development and to ensure that the Local Planning Authority may be satisfied that CO2 emission reduction targets are met in accordance with Policy CP20 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), Policies DMD49, DMD50 and DMD51 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

The development must achieve reduced water consumption through the use of water efficient fittings, appliances and recycling systems to result in consumption equal to or less than 105 litres per person per day.Reason: To promote water conservation and efficiency measures in all new developments and where possible in the retrofitting of existing stock in accordance with Core Policy 21 of the Core Strategy and the London Plan.
